messages.author: d7ee34c7589817da
messages.subject: Preferential Sampling model produces error
parts:
Hi all,

I was trying to run the preferential sampling model example provided here: https://github.com/inlabru-org/inlabru/issues/57

But I got the same error message as mentioned in one of the reply:

Warning in iinla(model = info[["model"]], lhoods = info[["lhoods"]], options = info[["options"]]) :
  iinla: Problem in inla: Error in inla.set.hyper(model, section, hyper = hyper.default, debug = debug) :
  Unknown keyword in `hyper' ` theta2 '. Must be one of  theta theta1 b beta.

It seems like I need to reinstall inlabru to solve this issue but I reinstalled to the newest version 2.4.0 but still the same issue. Can anyone help with this? Thank you very much!

David

messages.author: afb003e064114795
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Preferential Sampling model produces error
parts:
Hi,

That example code is now very old, there was a major update to the inlabru package about a year ago (the completion of the backend code rewrite that Fabian mentioned in the comments) as well as many updates to INLA itself.  If you can post a reproducible example (e.g. made with the “reprex” package, with reprex::reprex() ) on that inlabru issue page, that would help me debug it, or see if there are syntax issues in the code.

Finn

messages.author: afb003e064114795
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Preferential Sampling model produces error
parts:
Hi David,

I've posted the updated and working example at https://github.com/inlabru-org/inlabru/issues/57#issuecomment-1019489996
Most of the syntax changes (map --> main or unnamed, and requiring Intercept(1) instead of just Intercept in the component specification) were automatically corrected for, but specifying model=matern in the "copy" model likely only worked temporarily during the new backend development. The copy feature underwent a complete overhaul after that bug report.

Finn
